question: Which of the following peptides are not produced by the renal system?
analysis: The renal system is responsible for producing several important peptides and hormones. Renin is an enzyme produced by the juxtaglomerular cells of the kidney. Erythropoietin is a hormone produced by the kidneys that stimulates red blood cell production. 1,25-dihydroxycholecalciferol (1,25DHCC), also known as calcitriol, is the active form of vitamin D and is produced in the kidneys. Angiotensin I, however, is not produced by the renal system; it is formed in the bloodstream when renin acts on angiotensinogen, which is produced by the liver.
